summary: Tested MARGIN dry-run feature + new access values (analytics/call_analytics/dealers). Backend: 7/11 pytest cases passed. Found CRITICAL bug — PUT /api/users/{id} does NOT accept new access values (analytics, call_analytics, dealers) because /app/backend/routes/auth.py line 152 valid_access_values list was not updated when POST endpoint at line 90 was. Returns 400 'Invalid access value'. POST works correctly. Frontend: confirmed UserManagement Add+Edit dialogs both render all 11 access checkboxes including 'Analityka leadów' (analytics), 'Analityka połączeń' (call_analytics), 'Dilerzy' (dealers) with correct data-testids. Margin dry-run backend verified: row {price:13000, costPrice:12500} → margin object {oldAmount:null,newAmount:500,newPct:3.8}, lowMargin=true, marginThreshold=15.0, summary.marginAlerts=1. Roundtrip export→reimport of unchanged file produces marginAlerts=0 as expected.

critical.issue: valid_access_values list at /app/backend/routes/auth.py line 152 is missing 'analytics', 'call_analytics', 'dealers'. Editing any user and granting these new permissions returns 400 'Invalid access value: analytics. Must be one of: [balia, sauna, logistics, driver, warehouse, sauna_crm, sauna_production, training, all]'. Admins can create users with these access keys (POST works) but CANNOT edit them — breaks the UI flow described in this review request.

integration_issues.issue: UI shows the new checkboxes and lets admin toggle them, but submitting the form will fail with toast.error because PUT /api/users/{id} rejects the values. User sees generic 'Произошла ошибка' instead of useful feedback. Same root cause as backend critical bug.

action_items: FIX /app/backend/routes/auth.py line 152: add 'analytics', 'call_analytics', 'dealers' to valid_access_values in update_user() to mirror create_user() at line 90. Also consider extracting this list to a module-level constant (VALID_ACCESS_VALUES) to prevent future drift between POST/PUT validators.
Allowed roles list in update_user() (line 162) is also missing 'marketer' that is present in create_user (line 98). Same drift pattern; align both lists.
Minor React console warning observed on Users tab: 'Encountered two children with the same key' (pre-existing, not part of this review).
critical_code_review_comments: auth.py duplicates the valid_access_values literal between POST (line 90) and PUT (line 152). Already drifted (PUT missing 3 values + 'marketer' role). Refactor to module-level constants VALID_ACCESS_VALUES and VALID_ROLES used by both handlers.
sauna_excel.py MARGIN_ALERT_PCT=15.0 is hardcoded; consider env var or admin-config so threshold can be tuned without redeploy.

PriceImportExport.jsx DiffRow.showMargin operator precedence: `m.oldAmount !== null && m.oldAmount !== undefined || m.newAmount !== null && m.newAmount !== undefined` — works due to operator precedence but should be wrapped in parens for readability and to avoid future regression.
UserManagement.jsx getAccessBadge() legacy default labels are hardcoded English ('Balia', 'Sauna', 'Logistics') instead of using i18n txt strings, inconsistent with the rest of the file.
seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed with TEST_ are created and immediately deleted within each test (cleanup in fixture/finally blocks). One unchanged dry-run test exports current prices and re-uploads, no DB mutation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes auth.py PUT validator, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_access_and_margin.py — all 11 tests should pass. Margin feature + frontend UI for 11 access checkboxes already verified working. Did not test the LandingPage card-visibility flow for non-admin users with analytics/dealers access (blocked by PUT bug + token budget); recommend that scenario be exercised once backend is patched.
rca of the issue: Root cause: when adding new access keys 'analytics', 'call_analytics', 'dealers' the developer updated valid_access_values in create_user() (auth.py:90) but missed the second copy in update_user() (auth.py:152). Both endpoints validate independently with their own literal lists; no shared constant. Reproduction: 1) Login as admin. 2) PUT /api/users/{any_user_id} with {"access":["analytics"]} → 400. Mitigation: extract to module-level VALID_ACCESS_VALUES tuple and reference it from both handlers.
